title: Oozing Argentinian Cheese Stew
description: A garlicky, gooey stew that comforts on sick days, featuring a mustard-soffritto base and rich cheese.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and celery and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the Dijon mustard and stir to coat the vegetables, cooking for another minute.
Pour in the vegetable broth, bring to a simmer, and let it cook for 10 minutes to develop flavor.
Reduce the heat to low, stir in the heavy cream and shredded cheese, and cook for 5 minutes until the cheese melts and the stew thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then simmer gently for an additional 3 minutes.
Ladle the stew into bowls, garnish with chopped parsley, and serve hot.
